clue.text: Female apt to turn around and quarrel

indicators.note: turning around means the pair of pieces is read from back to front

parts.note: apt means fit, suitable

explanation.surface: A woman inclined to spin round and pick a fight.
explanation.definitionFit: A tiff is a petty squabble, a minor quarrel between people close to each other.

clue.text: The old woman coming in to try to sell native weapon

indicators.note: coming in tells us the mother piece enters the middle of the other pieces

parts.note: taken as written
to hawk goods is to peddle them, trying to sell them
'the old woman' is slang for one's mother, MA

explanation.surface: A mother arrives as someone is hawking a traditional weapon.
explanation.definitionFit: A tomahawk is the light axe used as a weapon by Native North American peoples.

clue.text: No one sadly in favour of starting in the morning

indicators.note: starting tells us the support piece comes at the beginning, before the jumbled letters

parts.note: being in favour of something is being for it

indicators.note: sadly signals that the letters of no one end up in a sorry, disordered state

explanation.surface: Nobody, unfortunately, is keen on getting going early in the day.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in the morning' looks like the definition, but 'in' belongs to 'in favour of'; 'starting' puts that piece first and 'sadly' scrambles the rest.
explanation.definitionFit: Forenoon is an old-fashioned word for the part of the day before midday.

clue.text: Green energy source that could get a person all agitated

indicators.note: agitated means stirred up, so the letters of a person all are shaken into a new order

explanation.surface: An eco-friendly power device that might get somebody all worked up.
explanation.definitionFit: A device turning sunlight into electricity is a renewable, environmentally friendly power supply.

clue.text: What's used by basket-maker, old gentleman outside back of house

indicators.note: outside says the piece for old gentleman wraps round the other letter

parts.note: sir is the title or form of address for a gentleman

indicators.note: the back of a word is its final letter

explanation.surface: An elderly gentleman stands outside the rear of a house, looking at a basket-maker's materials.
explanation.walkthrough: The E from the end of 'house' goes between the I and R of SIR, so O + SIER.
explanation.definitionFit: Willow shoots, flexible and long, are the classic material woven into baskets.

clue.text: Medical expert to go abroad, getting to the heart of the matter

parts.note: aller is the French verb meaning to go, so it is 'to go' in a foreign tongue
the gist is the essential point, the core of the matter

explanation.surface: A doctor heads overseas and gets to the core of an issue.
explanation.walkthrough: 'getting' is a link word. 'abroad' tells you to use a foreign word: the French verb for 'to go'.
explanation.definitionFit: A specialist doctor who diagnoses and treats hypersensitive reactions is a physician with expertise.

clue.text: Scheme, what's believed to allow accommodation of silver in royal house

parts.note: a scheme is a plan

indicators.note: accommodating something is giving it room inside, so the belief piece houses the metal

parts.note: a tenet is a principle or belief held
Ag is the chemical symbol for silver

explanation.surface: A plan and a principle that makes room for silver in a royal residence.
explanation.walkthrough: AG goes into TENET to give TAGENET.
explanation.definitionFit: This English dynasty ruled from Henry II to Richard III, a ruling family of kings.

clue.text: Those opposing audibly, making beastly noises

indicators.note: audibly says the word for opposers is heard, not written

parts.note: the nays are the votes or voters against a motion

explanation.surface: Opponents of a motion voicing objections like animals.
explanation.definitionFit: Horses' cries are noises made by beasts, hence 'beastly' in a literal sense.

clue.text: Smooth ambassador showing love for English

indicators.note: for says one letter stands in place of the other

parts.note: a legate is an envoy, especially of the Pope
love is nil in tennis, the letter O

explanation.surface: A suave diplomat shows affection for England.
explanation.walkthrough: The E at the end of LEGATE is replaced by O, from love meaning zero.
explanation.definitionFit: In music the term directs that notes be played smoothly and connected, without breaks.

clue.text: Horse that can be seen on the moon!

definitions.text: can be seen on the moon
definitions.meaning: the dark plains on the lunar surface are named seas, in Latin, such as the Sea of Tranquillity

explanation.surface: A horse spotted up on the moon.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means a female horse and also a dark basaltic plain on the lunar surface.

clue.text: Deceptive male is in charge

parts.note: being in charge means leading

explanation.surface: A man in authority is being dishonest.
explanation.definitionFit: Something deceptive gives a false impression, steering people towards wrong conclusions.

clue.text: Raymond heading off to become dog trainer?

indicators.note: heading off means the first letter is removed

parts.note: Raymond Chandler was the American crime writer who created Philip Marlowe

explanation.surface: A man called Raymond leaves to start a career training dogs.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who works with and controls a trained police or show dog is called this.

clue.text: Mad reasons to get vehicles using diesel?

parts.note: loco is slang for crazy
motives are reasons for doing something

explanation.surface: Crazy justifications for buying diesel cars.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark marks the definition as one example: diesel engines are one kind among steam and electric ones.
explanation.definitionFit: Railway engines that pull trains are often diesel-powered, so they are such vehicles.

clue.text: Rodent caught by the unusual mechanical device

parts.note: a rat is a rodent
C is the cricket abbreviation for caught

indicators.note: unusual signals the letters of the are put in an odd order

explanation.surface: A rat trapped by some strange contraption.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unusual' makes HET from THE; 'by' just joins the pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: A toothed wheel with a pawl that allows motion in one direction only is a mechanism.

clue.text: Job of someone working on box?

definitions.text: Job of someone working on box?

parts.words: Job of someone working on box?
parts.note: box suggests television or a container, but boxwood is a fine timber used by craftsmen who shape it with chisels

explanation.surface: What does a person employed on the telly do?
explanation.walkthrough: 'working on box' suggests television work; the box here is the tree whose dense timber carvers prize.
explanation.definitionFit: Shaping box timber with chisels and knives is the craft of a sculptor in timber.

clue.text: Steps to effect climate change for the better?

definitions.text: Steps to effect climate change for the better?

parts.words: Steps to effect climate change for the better?
parts.note: steps sounds like policy measures, but here they are literal dance steps meant to bring on wet weather

explanation.surface: What measures could improve the climate crisis?
explanation.walkthrough: 'Steps' and 'climate change' point to environmental policy; the steps are a ritual dance performed to bring rain in a drought.
explanation.definitionFit: A ceremonial dance performed to summon rainfall is meant to alter the weather favourably.

clue.text: Let's have no more pets in peril

definitions.note: the definition is short for 'put in peril', a verb

parts.note: to end something is to have no more of it
a pet is a fit of sulking or bad temper, so pets are anger

explanation.surface: A plea to stop keeping animals that are at risk.
explanation.walkthrough: Pets here are fits of pique, not animals: END ANGER is 'let's have no more tantrums'.
explanation.definitionFit: To expose someone to danger or harm is to put them at risk.

clue.text: This person, a certain Democrat, is moderate in speech maybe

parts.note: this person is the setter, ME
certain means sure
D is the abbreviation for a Democrat in US politics

explanation.surface: I, a confident Democrat, am restrained in the way I talk.
explanation.definitionFit: Words described this way are careful and restrained, deliberately weighed rather than extreme.

clue.text: Awfully ancient men securing a means of support

indicators.note: securing means holding fast, so the shuffled letters hold the single letter within them
awfully signals the letters of ancient men are mangled into a new order

explanation.surface: Terribly old men are getting hold of some income.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Awfully' rearranges ANCIENT MEN; 'securing' puts A inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Payments made to support a former spouse or child, or upkeep generally, provide sustenance.

clue.text: Dish carried by Esau ceremoniously

indicators.note: carried by means the answer is held inside the letters of the words Esau ceremoniously

explanation.surface: A plate borne solemnly by the biblical Esau.
explanation.definitionFit: A small shallow plate set under a cup is a kind of dish.

clue.text: Decamp from Eastern Mediterranean area

definitions.meaning: an old British slang verb for running off, especially to escape debts
the historic name for the lands of the eastern Mediterranean coast such as Syria and Lebanon

explanation.surface: Clear off out of the Middle East.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means to abscond, and as a noun it names the region of the eastern Mediterranean shore.

clue.text: Warded off wild guy losing head, Fifties-style rocker

indicators.note: losing head means the first letter is dropped

parts.note: a raver is a wild partygoer
a Ted, short for Teddy boy, was a 1950s British youth in Edwardian-style dress who loved rock and roll

explanation.surface: Fended off a wild man who lost his head, a rock-and-roller from the fifties.
explanation.definitionFit: To avert danger is to turn it aside or prevent it, as one fends off a blow.

clue.text: Governors of ancient city-state to the west

indicators.note: to the west in an across clue means reading leftwards, back to front

parts.note: Sparta was the ancient Greek city-state; 'of' it is the possessive Sparta's

explanation.surface: Rulers of an old Greek city going westwards.
explanation.walkthrough: The apostrophe of SPARTA'S is dropped, as usual in crosswords.
explanation.definitionFit: These were provincial governors in the ancient Persian empire, a word now used for petty rulers.

clue.text: Muddy liquid getting left out — one sort of exotic food

indicators.note: left out means the letter for left is omitted from the word

parts.note: slush is melting snow or watery mud
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A dirty liquid is left aside in favour of an exotic dish.
explanation.definitionFit: Japanese vinegared rice with raw fish is a dish that once seemed foreign and unusual in the West.

clue.text: Frightfully vain chum is showing fanatical pride

indicators.note: frightfully signals the letters of vain chum is are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: A terribly conceited friend displays a zealous self-regard.
explanation.definitionFit: Excessive and prejudiced loyalty to one's own nation, sex or group is overzealous partisanship.

clue.text: Characters in sea garnered seaweed

indicators.note: characters in means letters found inside the words sea garnered

explanation.surface: Letters picked out at the shore yield marine plant matter.
explanation.definitionFit: A jelly made from red marine algae, used in cooking and labs, is named for the weed it comes from.

clue.text: Restaurant serving rubbish is located by southern lake

parts.note: rot means nonsense, rubbish
Erie is one of the North American Great Lakes

explanation.surface: An eatery serving junk sits beside a lake in the south.
explanation.definitionFit: A rotisserie is an eatery specialising in meat roasted on a spit.

clue.text: Egg on quiet little boy

parts.note: P is the musical abbreviation for piano, quiet
Rod is a short form of the boy's name Rodney

explanation.surface: Urging on a silent small child.
explanation.definitionFit: To prod someone is to goad or urge them into action.
